## Why a scatterplot fails

An outcome that takes only the values 0 and 1 puts every point of a scatterplot on one of two horizontal stripes.
Dots on the same stripe overlap wherever the feature takes similar values, so the plot hides how many observations there are.
Two plots avoid this: a rug and a pair of histograms.
